description: For non-DM JidoChat thread replies, route replies rooted in a ZAQ-authored message without requiring a mention; for roots authored by others or unknown, require an explicit ZAQ mention. Preserve current DM behavior, self-message filtering, reply hooks, and exactly-once processing. Add regression tests. Action reuse assessment: operation is local ingress admission in Zaq.Channels.JidoChatBridge; inspected existing Chat handlers, handle_message_event/3, handle_subscribed_message/1, and normal Engine routing. Decision: local-only extension of the bridge's existing handler routing because this is adapter-bound event classification with no standalone Action contract. Inputs are normalized Jido.Chat.Incoming plus configured bot identity/root metadata; output is existing :ok/error behavior and existing routing/hook side effects. Consumers remain JidoChat listener/webhook paths; no agent tool/workflow exposure. Verification: handler tests covering ZAQ root, other/unknown root with and without mention, DMs unchanged, self filtering, and no duplicate pipeline dispatch. E2E not needed: transport ingress policy is covered deterministically at bridge integration/unit level with no UI journey.
title: Handle JidoChat replies by thread root author
